# Peter De Smidt

> Service designer and design researcher working across enterprise service design, customer experience, invisible infrastructure, spatial experience, harm reduction, and systems change.

Peter De Smidt is a service designer and design researcher with experience in professional service design, customer experience research, enterprise transformation, qualitative and quantitative research, design strategy, and STS-informed design practice.

## Professional profile

Peter works across professional service design and design research, with a focus on making complex systems legible through research, artifacts, service maps, synthesis, and strategic storytelling. His work is especially relevant to organizations hiring service designers, CX researchers, design strategists, innovation researchers, and systems-oriented designers.

## Academic profile

Peter’s academic work spans design research, Science and Technology Studies, experiential design, spatial design, harm reduction, public health, care infrastructures, and invisible labor. His portfolio is relevant to graduate programs in design research, service design, design studies, STS, systems design, spatial experience, and interdisciplinary design.
